title: Computer Vision
description: Teach the robot to see AprilTags: feed camera tag solutions to the pose estimator so the robot always knows where it is on the field, then aim at the goal from that estimate.

checkpoints.title: Camera tag solutions added
checkpoints.description: LocalizationSubsystem.updateLogic() gives each camera tag solution to the pose estimator with addVisionMeasurement(): the pose the camera saw, the time the picture was taken, and the standard deviations.

checkpoints.title: Estimate within 6 cm and 1 degree
checkpoints.description: Start fresh, enable Teleop and drive around (W/A/S/D) for at least 5 meters in total, with at least a quarter turn in it, then stop and wait 2 seconds. Once the robot has sat still, your estimate must be within 6 centimeters and 1 degree of where the robot really is. Choose better VISION_XY_STD_METERS and VISION_HEADING_STD_RADIANS if it is not.

checkpoints.title: Aim state written
checkpoints.description: DriveStates has AIM, the switch handles it with a PIDController (continuous input) that reads the pose estimate, getAngleToGoal() and isAimed() are written, and DrivetrainCommands.aim() starts and ends the state.

checkpoints.title: Aims within 2 degrees
checkpoints.description: Start fresh, enable Teleop and hold the left bumper (E). The robot should turn to face the goal and stay within 2 degrees of it for half a second, within 4 seconds. Raise AIM_KP if it stops short.

checkpoints.title: No wild overshoot
checkpoints.description: On that same aim, the robot must not swing more than 10 degrees past the goal. Lower AIM_KP or add AIM_KD to damp it.
